newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemen discusses border dispute with Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Yemen discusses border dispute with Saudi.

text.p: Yemen's President Ali Abdullah Saleh has written to Saudi Arabia's King Fahd about a border dispute between the two countries, the official Saudi Press Agency reported.
It said Yemeni Interior Minister Hussein Mohammad Arab delivered the letter at a meeting with King Fahd on Tuesday night following talks with Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef.
"There is no doubt the letter...will give a great push to reach an agreement...on the border issue," SPA quoted Prince Nayef as saying.

Nayef visited Yemen early this month in a further attempt to resolve the 61-year border dispute which has led to several minor clashes between the Arab world's richest oil power and one of its poorest countries.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding in 1995 in an attempt to end the row. Since then they have exchanged high-level visits and held joint meetings to resolve the issue.
